svg.text: Genesis 11 — Babel: One Language, One Tower
verse 8 — So Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building.
Shinar is the Mesopotamian plain of Genesis 10:10; the tower's form follows the ziggurats built there
a plain in the land of Shinar
scattered abroad on the surface of all the earth
twice from below, once from above
and make a name for us
